```{r}
#| label: params
# Parameters --------------------------------------------------------------------
# Every figure in every 2026-11 run folder (user, 2026-11-10), superseded ones included.
RUNS_DIR <- "experiments/runs"
RUN_PATTERN <- "^2026-11-"
# The summary and this report are outputs of the report, not runs.
SKIP_RUNS <- c("2026-11-10_bmv-summary", "2026-11-10_bmv-report")
OUT_DIR <- "experiments/runs/2026-11-10_bmv-report/figures_all"
# Runs whose figures already came from lucid-coder save_panel (pdf + png + csv, 2026-11-10 forks).
LUCID_RUNS <- c(
  "2026-11-10_bmv-marker-flags",
  "2026-11-10_bmv-th2-proof",
  "2026-11-10_bmv-downstream-opt188",
  "2026-11-10_bmv-af405-forced-af",
  "2026-11-10_bmv-spike-in"
)
```

```{r}
#| label: setup
# Paths are repo-root relative; the notebook sits three levels below the root.
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = normalizePath("../../.."))
# Markdown image links resolve from this folder, so they carry the "../../.." prefix.
```

```{r}
#| label: libraries
source("experiments/benchmarks/05_bmv-unmix-compare/report_figures.R")
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(stringr)
  library(tibble)
})
```

```{r}
#| label: inventory
# Figure files ------------------------------------------------------------------
# One row per figure stem; a stem saved as png and pdf is one figure.
fig_files <- list.files(RUNS_DIR, pattern = "\\.(png|pdf|jpg)$", recursive = TRUE)
inventory <- tibble(file = fig_files) |>
  mutate(
    run = str_extract(.data$file, "^[^/]+"),
    stem = str_remove(.data$file, "\\.(png|pdf|jpg)$"),
    ext = str_extract(.data$file, "[a-z]+$")
  ) |>
  filter(str_detect(.data$run, RUN_PATTERN), !.data$run %in% SKIP_RUNS) |>
  summarise(formats = paste(sort(unique(ext)), collapse = "+"), .by = c(run, stem))

# Saved source table ------------------------------------------------------------
# A figure's table is <stem>_source.csv, a <prefix>_source*.csv whose prefix starts the stem
# (fig_a_source.csv for fig_a_pct_pos), or source_data/<stem>.csv beside a panels folder.
find_source <- function(stem) {
  dir <- file.path(RUNS_DIR, dirname(stem))
  base <- basename(stem)
  in_dir <- list.files(dir, pattern = "_source.*\\.csv$")
  prefix <- str_remove(in_dir, "_source.*\\.csv$")
  hits <- in_dir[base == prefix | str_starts(base, paste0(prefix, "_"))]
  hits <- hits[order(-nchar(hits))]
  panel <- file.path(dir, "source_data", paste0(base, ".csv"))
  cands <- c(file.path(dir, hits), panel[file.exists(panel)])
  if (length(cands) > 0) cands[[1]] else NA_character_
}

# Run tables that hold the plotted values of a figure with no _source.csv (checked by hand
# against the producing scripts 37b, 39b, 43, 66, 67, 69, 81, 82).
MANUAL_SOURCES <- tribble(
  ~stem                                                     , ~src                                                      ,
  "2026-11-10_bmv-swap-test/fig_scores"                     , "2026-11-10_bmv-swap-test/scores.csv"                     ,
  "2026-11-10_bmv-variant-count/fig_scores"                 , "2026-11-10_bmv-variant-count/scores.csv"                 ,
  "2026-11-10_bmv-gls-noise/scores/fig_scores"              , "2026-11-10_bmv-gls-noise/scores/scores.csv"              ,
  "2026-11-10_bmv-opt188/report/fig_opt188_readouts"        , "2026-11-10_bmv-opt188/report/opt188_readouts.csv"        ,
  "2026-11-10_bmv-coherence-or/fig_coherence_or"            , "2026-11-10_bmv-coherence-or/coherence_or.csv"            ,
  "2026-11-10_bmv-ssm-188/fig_ssm_188"                      , "2026-11-10_bmv-ssm-188/ssm_long.csv"                     ,
  "2026-11-10_bmv-own-ssm/fig_own_ssm"                      , "2026-11-10_bmv-own-ssm/own_ssm.csv"                      ,
  "2026-11-10_bmv-ifng-tnfneg-v2/fig_b_share_tnfpos"        , "2026-11-10_bmv-ifng-tnfneg-v2/share_tnfpos.csv"
) |>
  mutate(src = file.path(RUNS_DIR, .data$src))

with_source <- inventory |>
  mutate(src = map_chr(.data$stem, find_source)) |>
  rows_update(MANUAL_SOURCES, by = "stem", unmatched = "ignore")
with_source <- with_source |>
  mutate(
    sig = map_chr(
      .data$src,
      \(s) if (is.na(s)) NA_character_ else table_signature(s) # LAYOUTS key, without a condition column
    )
  )
```


```{r}
#| label: redraw
# Redraw ------------------------------------------------------------------------
# A figure with a mapped table is redrawn; a stem copied into bmv-figures-v2 points to its original.
stopifnot("output dir is new" = !dir.exists(OUT_DIR))
dir.create(OUT_DIR, recursive = TRUE)

to_draw <- with_source |>
  mutate(layout = unname(LAYOUTS[.data$sig])) |>
  filter(!.data$run %in% LUCID_RUNS)
# A dataset with conditions stops on a table no layout maps; 3D keeps the inventory status "table layout not mapped".
unmapped <- filter(to_draw, is.na(.data$layout), !is.na(.data$src))
if (!is.null(DS$conditions) && nrow(unmapped) > 0) {
  stop(
    "91_all_figures.qmd: no LAYOUTS entry for the table of ",
    nrow(unmapped),
    " figure(s) of dataset ",
    DS$dataset,
    ": ",
    paste(unmapped$stem, collapse = ", "),
    call. = FALSE
  )
}
to_draw <- filter(to_draw, !is.na(.data$layout))

drawn <- to_draw |>
  mutate(
    res = pmap(
      list(.data$src, .data$layout, .data$stem, .data$run),
      \(src, layout, stem, run) {
        name <- str_replace_all(str_remove(stem, paste0("^", run, "/")), "/", "__")
        redraw_panel(src, layout, basename(stem), file.path(OUT_DIR, run), name)
      }
    )
  ) |>
  unnest(res)
```

```{r}
#| label: inventory-write
# Inventory ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# One row per original figure: the redrawn path, or why it was not redrawn.
PER_CELL <- "tnf_vs|ssc_vs|fsc_vs|cd3_tnf|cd3_cd8|strategy_|gates?_|tree_|_vs_|hex|scatter|pseudocolor|ggcyto|cell_rectangles|bv510_density"
status <- with_source |>
  left_join(select(drawn, stem, redrawn, caption), by = join_by(stem), relationship = "one-to-one") |>
  mutate(
    status = case_when(
      .data$run %in% LUCID_RUNS ~ "already lucid style (save_panel)",
      # save_panel writes <stem>.pdf, .png and .csv side by side; forks that started after this list.
      .data$formats == "pdf+png" & file.exists(file.path(RUNS_DIR, paste0(.data$stem, ".csv"))) ~
        "already lucid style (save_panel)",
      !is.na(.data$redrawn) ~ .data$redrawn,
      str_detect(.data$stem, "/figure_[^/]+/") | .data$formats == "jpg" ~
        "not redrawn: AutoSpectral package diagnostic, no saved table",
      !is.na(.data$src) ~ paste0("not redrawn: table layout not mapped (", basename(.data$src), ")"),
      str_detect(basename(.data$stem), PER_CELL) ~ "not redrawn: needs raw events (per-cell plot)",
      .default = "not redrawn: no saved table"
    )
  )

# Copies under bmv-figures-v2 take the status of the figure they copy.
copies <- status |>
  filter(.data$run == "2026-11-10_bmv-figures-v2", is.na(.data$redrawn)) |>
  mutate(
    original = str_remove(.data$stem, "^2026-11-10_bmv-figures-v2/") |>
      str_replace("^gated-pooled/", "2026-11-10_bmv-gated-pooled/")
  ) |>
  left_join(
    select(status, original = stem, original_status = status),
    by = join_by(original),
    relationship = "many-to-one"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    status = if_else(
      is.na(.data$original_status),
      .data$status,
      paste0("copy of ", .data$original, "; ", str_remove(.data$original_status, "^not redrawn: "))
    )
  )
inventory_out <- status |>
  rows_update(select(copies, stem, status), by = "stem") |>
  transmute(run, original_figure = paste0(stem, " [", formats, "]"), redrawn_or_reason = status)
write_csv(inventory_out, file.path(OUT_DIR, "inventory.csv"))
```

```{r}
#| label: counts
inventory_counts <- inventory_out |>
  mutate(
    outcome = case_when(
      str_starts(.data$redrawn_or_reason, OUT_DIR) ~ "redrawn",
      str_starts(.data$redrawn_or_reason, "already") ~ "already lucid style",
      str_starts(.data$redrawn_or_reason, "copy of") ~ "copy of another run's figure",
      .default = str_remove(.data$redrawn_or_reason, " \\(.*\\)$")
    )
  ) |>
  count(outcome, sort = TRUE)
knitr::kable(inventory_counts, col.names = c("Outcome", "Figures"))
```

`r nrow(inventory_out)` figures sit in the run folders; `r nrow(drawn)` were redrawn from their saved tables and the rest are listed in `figures_all/inventory.csv` with the reason.

```{r}
#| label: show
#| results: asis
# One section per run folder: its sentence, then each redrawn figure with its caption.
for (one_run in unique(status$run)) {
  run_rows <- filter(drawn, .data$run == one_run)
  run_status <- filter(status, .data$run == one_run)
  cat("\n\n## ", one_run, "\n\n", sep = "")
  cat(sprintf(
    "%d of %d figures in this folder were redrawn from saved tables.\n\n",
    nrow(run_rows),
    nrow(run_status)
  ))
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(run_rows))) {
    cat(sprintf(
      "![%s %s](%s){width=100%%}\n\n",
      basename(run_rows$stem[[i]]),
      run_rows$caption[[i]],
      file.path("../../..", run_rows$redrawn[[i]])
    ))
  }
}
```
